reason: The plugin extends DeepSeek Harness web UI access to LAN devices by changing the server bind address and injecting a UUID polyfill; its documented lack of authentication creates a high-impact exposure requiring human review.

summaries.zh: 将 DeepSeek Harness 的 Web UI 暴露到局域网，并注入 crypto.randomUUID 兼容补丁以支持非安全上下文启动。
summaries.en: Exposes the DeepSeek Harness Web UI to the local network and injects a crypto.randomUUID compatibility polyfill for startup in non-secure contexts.

capabilities: Binds the DeepSeek Harness web server to 0.0.0.0 through an overlay
Makes the DeepSeek Harness web UI accessible from LAN devices
Injects a crypto.randomUUID polyfill into the web page
Can expose remote code execution capabilities to the LAN because the web UI has no authentication layer
